label: Deal three each
hint: Three cards, face up, into each seat's hand.
announce: {name} dealt three cards to each seat.

label: Catch pairs
hint: Lay every pair that is held face up in the middle.

label: Reset
hint: Put the table back as it was when it began: a fresh, shuffled deck.
confirm: This takes every card off the table and lays it out again. Continue?

label: Collect all cards
hint: Every card back into the deck, face down, shuffled.
announce: {name} collected every card into the deck.
